fact: On 23 September 2025 the Minister of Education and National Pedagogy chaired a coordination meeting at UNESCO's office in Port Sudan to discuss developing the education management information system and a shared vision for digital transformation of the sector, within the Transitional Education Plan 2025-2027, with the Ministry of Interior committing to link data and supply student information.
title: وزير التعليم والتربية الوطنية: نظام إدارة المعلومات التربوية هو استثمار استراتيجي في رأس المال البشري
